other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Unsupervised Text Feature Extraction
other_failure_modes.description: Fitting text vectorizers (like TF-IDF) on the combined train and test datasets leaks the vocabulary and document frequency statistics of the test set into the training process.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
all_title = pd.concat([title_train, title_test], ignore_index=True)

summary: The agent implements a generally robust pipeline with proper out-of-fold target encoding, text-feature stacking via Ridge regression, and LightGBM. However, the solution suffers from data leakage due to calculating grouped price standardisation and fitting TF-IDF on the combined train and test sets. Crucially, it ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a standard random K-Fold cross-validation, which introduces look-ahead bias.
